verdict.rationale: Logseq's export docs say it can export the entire graph in EDN, JSON, standard Markdown, OPML, Roam JSON and HTML, and that exports can cover selections, pages or the whole graph. Community users confirm their data lives in local files they keep in git, which makes leaving straightforward. One user notes the on-disk Org/Markdown is non-standard, and another says the new database format no longer keeps data as markdown files; neither contradicts the documented export, so they lower the score rather than create a dispute. missing for 10: evidence that whole-graph export works for the new database version, export fidelity for assets and attachments, independent hands-on corroboration of a full-graph export round-trip.
